title: TikTok Shop Top Product Intelligence v6
description: Advanced multi-source TikTok Shop product intelligence with recent sales windows, commission, optional creator/video enrichment, persistent history, data-quality diagnostics and confidence-adjusted opportunity scoring.

region.title: Region
region.description: TikTok Shop market. Germany is recommended for the current DE workflow.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Product search terms such as Beauty, Airfryer, Saugroboter, Parfum or Skincare.

categories.title: Market-intelligence categories
categories.description: Optional TikTok Shop category names. Leave empty for a keyword-only test.

marketOverallTop.title: Use overall market top list
marketOverallTop.description: Request the overall top products for the selected country instead of limiting market intelligence to the entered keywords/categories.

searchActorId.title: Base search Actor
searchActorId.description: Actor used for local price, cumulative sold count, rating, shop, image and product URL.

marketActorId.title: Market intelligence Actor
marketActorId.description: Actor used for last-day and last-7-day units sold, revenue growth, commission and launch-date data.

creatorsActorId.title: Creator intelligence Actor
creatorsActorId.description: Optional Actor used to find creators selling selected products and aggregate creator metrics.

videosActorId.title: Video intelligence Actor
videosActorId.description: Optional Actor used to find shoppable product videos and aggregate views and engagement.

maxSearchItemsPerQuery.title: Max base-search products per query
maxSearchItemsPerQuery.description: Maximum products requested from the base search source for each keyword.

maxMarketItemsPerSource.title: Max market-intelligence products per source
maxMarketItemsPerSource.description: Maximum market-intelligence rows requested for each keyword/category in each time window.

maxOutputProducts.title: Max products in final output
maxOutputProducts.description: Maximum ranked products written to the final Dataset.

enableMarketIntelligence.title: Enable recent market intelligence
enableMarketIntelligence.description: Fetch last-day and last-7-day market metrics for recent units sold, revenue growth and commission when available.

includeMarketOnlyProducts.title: Include products found only by market intelligence
includeMarketOnlyProducts.description: Add strong market-intelligence products even when the base search did not return them.

enableMarketPaidAnalytics.title: Enable paid product analytics
enableMarketPaidAnalytics.description: Request optional creator count, video count, review count, price range and other provider analytics. This can increase cost and availability depends on the provider.

enableCreatorEnrichment.title: Enable creator enrichment
enableCreatorEnrichment.description: For the strongest products, fetch creators selling them and calculate observed creator count, creator revenue, units and content views for the last 7 days.

enableVideoEnrichment.title: Enable video enrichment
enableVideoEnrichment.description: For the strongest products, fetch shoppable videos and calculate video count, views, likes, comments, shares, engagement and video revenue for the last 7 days.

maxEnrichmentProducts.title: Max products for creator/video enrichment
maxEnrichmentProducts.description: Only this many strongest products are sent to optional creator/video enrichment. Keep small for testing and cost control.

maxCreatorsPerProduct.title: Max creators per product
maxCreatorsPerProduct.description: Maximum creator rows requested per enriched product.

maxVideosPerProduct.title: Max videos per product
maxVideosPerProduct.description: Maximum video rows requested per enriched product.

trackHistory.title: Track own history
trackHistory.description: Persist snapshots across runs for independent price history, sales deltas, creator/review growth and stock changes.

historyStoreName.title: History Key-value store
historyStoreName.description: Persistent named Key-value store used for product history across Actor runs.

maxSnapshotsPerProduct.title: Max snapshots per product
maxSnapshotsPerProduct.description: Maximum own historical snapshots retained for each product.

windowToleranceHours.title: History baseline tolerance (hours)
windowToleranceHours.description: Maximum time difference allowed when matching own snapshots to 24-hour, 7-day and 14-day baselines.

priceMode.title: Base price normalization
priceMode.description: Auto interprets large integer-like base-search prices as minor units; raw never divides; minor_units always divides by Price divisor.

priceDivisor.title: Price divisor
priceDivisor.description: Divisor used for minor-unit prices. Use 100 for euro cents.

autoMinorUnitThreshold.title: Auto minor-unit threshold
autoMinorUnitThreshold.description: In auto mode, integer-like raw prices at or above this value are divided by Price divisor.

onlyDiscounted.title: Only discounted products
onlyDiscounted.description: Keep only products with a positive discount percentage.

onlyInStock.title: Only in-stock products
onlyInStock.description: Keep only products for which a source explicitly exposes inStock=true.

minDiscount.title: Minimum discount %
minDiscount.description: Minimum discount percentage required in final output.

minSoldTotal.title: Minimum total sold
minSoldTotal.description: Minimum cumulative soldCount from the base search source.

minSold24h.title: Minimum sold 24h
minSold24h.description: Minimum recent units sold in the last day. Zero disables this filter.

minSold7d.title: Minimum sold 7d
minSold7d.description: Minimum recent units sold in the last 7 days. Zero disables this filter.

minCommissionPercent.title: Minimum commission %
minCommissionPercent.description: Minimum affiliate commission percentage required when commission data is available.

minCreatorCount.title: Minimum creator count
minCreatorCount.description: Minimum creator count required. Zero disables this filter.

minVideoViews7d.title: Minimum video views 7d
minVideoViews7d.description: Minimum aggregated shoppable-video views in the 7-day enrichment window. Zero disables this filter.

minTopProductScore.title: Minimum top-product score
minTopProductScore.description: Minimum confidence-adjusted opportunity score required. Keep zero during initial testing.

sortBy.title: Sort results by
sortBy.description: Metric used for final product ranking.

includeRawProviderData.title: Include raw base-provider data
includeRawProviderData.description: Include the original base-search row inside each product for debugging and field discovery.
